Title: Add QR instant fare quote before existing request confirmation
Problem / Request: Preserve the working QR and request flow. Add only a compact rider-phone quote step for From where, Where to, and Pickup time. Calculate and display a Pulse fare before confirmation, then continue through the existing standalone request app and lifecycle unchanged. No new website or second backend.
Acceptance Criteria: Quote calculation creates no request row; Confirm Ride creates exactly one request through the current writer; fare uses approved distance/time/minimum rules; competitor estimates are optional and never invented; current email, Calendar, Inbox, Scheduled, Ride ID/PIN, status, and lifecycle remain unchanged; deterministic no-write tests pass; review package and rollback are saved; no automatic deployment.
Integration Hooks: OSRM/Turf route-distance adapters and later Valhalla support the quote engine. Locomotion/Amit/Boomer patterns inform the compact UI; competitor fares are never invented.

builder.usage: No AI used during the Builder run — PULSE-059 source and validation are embedded in Builder v0.5.8.
